verdict.rationale: Wise's own docs cover banking (multi-currency accounts holding balances in up to 56 currencies, with opt-in passthrough FDIC insurance), spend (debit cards with spending permissions and MCC/currency spend controls), and outbound business payments, including batches of up to 1000 transfers. Bill pay as a dedicated workflow is not evidenced, and no source states that Wise is positioned as a single platform replacing separate spend, bill pay and banking tools. missing for 10: dedicated bill pay workflow (invoice capture, approvals, scheduled bill payments), an explicit consolidated-platform or replacement claim, independent corroboration of founders consolidating onto Wise.

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform

citations.quote: The Wise multi-currency account (MCA) enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies.
Opt in and get passthrough FDIC insurance up to $250,000 through our Program Bank.
Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
How to make business payments via API from a Wise account.
A batch group is a named collection of up to 1000 transfers that can be managed as a single unit.
